66:8.text: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps
your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow

the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."

66:9.text: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

66:10.text: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them,
did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."

66:11.text: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

66:12.text: Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into
, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
